seoContent.title: The Best Way to Compress PDF Files Online

content.heading: Why PDF Files Get So Large
content.text: PDF files grow large for several reasons: embedded high-resolution images, multiple fonts, form data, annotations, and metadata. A simple report can balloon to 50MB if it contains unoptimized images or scanned pages. SlimPDF's Ghostscript engine analyzes your PDF and compresses each element intelligently, reducing file size without destroying quality.

content.heading: Browser Compression vs Server Compression
content.text: Most free PDF compressors run JavaScript in your browser. They're limited by browser memory and can only apply basic compression, typically achieving 20-40% reduction. SlimPDF runs Ghostscript on dedicated servers, the same engine used by professional publishers. This allows compression ratios up to 90% and handles files that would crash browser-based tools.

content.heading: When to Use Each Compression Level
content.text: Maximum compression is best for text-heavy documents, forms, and files you need to email. Balanced compression works well for documents with some images where you want good quality and smaller size. Minimum compression is ideal when quality is critical, like portfolios, presentations with photos, or documents for printing.

content.heading: Compressing Scanned PDFs
content.text: Scanned documents are essentially large images wrapped in PDF format. These often compress dramatically, sometimes by 80-90%. If your scanned PDF is too large, SlimPDF can reduce it significantly while keeping text readable. For best results on scanned docs, use Maximum compression.

quality.question: Will compression reduce my PDF quality?
quality.answer: SlimPDF uses intelligent compression that removes unnecessary data while preserving visual quality. Text stays crisp, images stay clear. For documents where quality is critical, use Minimum compression to prioritize appearance over file size.

howMuch.question: How much smaller will my PDF get?
howMuch.answer: Results depend on your PDF content. Documents with many images typically compress 60-90%. Text-heavy PDFs may compress 20-50%. Scanned documents often see the best results. You'll see the exact reduction after compression.

email.question: How do I compress a PDF for email?
email.answer: Upload your PDF, select Maximum compression, and download the result. If you need a specific size (like under 10MB for Gmail), upgrade to Pro and use the Target Size feature to compress to exactly the size you need.

secure.question: Is my PDF secure?
secure.answer: Yes. All uploads use 256-bit SSL encryption. Files are processed in isolated containers and automatically deleted after 1 hour (free) or 24 hours (Pro). We never access, read, or store your content.

batch.question: Can I compress multiple PDFs at once?
batch.answer: Pro users can batch compress up to 20 PDFs simultaneously. Upload multiple files, compress them all with one click, and download results as a ZIP file.

api.question: Can I compress PDFs via API?
api.answer: Yes. Pro subscribers get full REST API access. Send a PDF via HTTP POST, receive a compressed version. See our API docs for code examples in Python, JavaScript, curl, and more.

encrypted.question: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?
encrypted.answer: You'll need to remove the password first. If you know the password, use our PDF Unlock tool to remove protection, then compress the unlocked file.

size.question: What's the maximum file size?
size.answer: Free tier accepts files up to 20MB. Pro tier handles files up to 100MB. For files larger than 100MB, contact us about our Business tier.

mobile.question: Can I compress PDFs on my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes. SlimPDF works in mobile browsers on iPhone and Android. No app required. Just open slimpdf.io, upload your PDF, and download the compressed version.

offline.question: Does this work offline?
offline.answer: No. SlimPDF requires an internet connection because compression runs on our servers. This is what allows us to achieve 90% compression ratios that browser-based tools can't match.

seoContent.title: The Easiest Way to Combine PDF Files Online

content.heading: Why Combine Multiple PDFs?
content.text: Combining PDFs creates one organized document from multiple files. This is essential for creating complete document packages, assembling contracts with attachments, merging scanned pages into one file, or building portfolios. A single merged PDF is easier to share, email, print, and archive.

content.heading: How PDF Merging Works
content.text: When you merge PDFs with SlimPDF, we combine internal page structures without re-encoding content. This preserves original quality, fonts, hyperlinks, and formatting. Unlike tools that convert pages to images, our server-side processing maintains full document fidelity.

content.heading: Combining Scanned and Digital PDFs
content.text: Both scanned documents (image-based) and digital PDFs (text-based) combine seamlessly. Scanned pages stay as images while digital pages keep their searchable text and vector graphics. The combined output maintains each page's original characteristics.

content.heading: Tips for Merging PDF Files
content.text: Before merging, check that all PDFs are oriented correctly. Consider compressing large files first to keep the combined PDF manageable. For documents with many pages, arrange files carefully since the merge follows your exact order. Pro users can combine unlimited files at once.

quality.question: Will merging reduce PDF quality?
quality.answer: No. SlimPDF preserves original quality when combining PDFs. Text stays sharp, images stay clear, and all formatting is maintained. We merge page structures without re-encoding.

order.question: Can I change the page order before merging?
order.answer: Yes. After uploading, drag files to arrange them in any order. The combined PDF follows your exact arrangement.

pageCount.question: Is there a limit on pages?
pageCount.answer: No page limit. Free users can merge up to 5 files per day. Pro users can merge unlimited files with no daily limit.

secure.question: Are my PDFs secure when merging?
secure.answer: Yes. All uploads use 256-bit SSL encryption. Files are processed in isolated containers and auto-deleted after 1 hour (free) or 24 hours (Pro).

encrypted.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
encrypted.answer: You need to remove passwords first. Use our PDF Unlock tool to remove protection, then merge the unlocked files.

different.question: Can I merge PDFs with different page sizes?
different.answer: Yes. PDFs with different page sizes (A4, Letter, custom) merge perfectly. Each page keeps its original dimensions in the combined file.

api.question: Can I merge PDFs via API?
api.answer: Yes. Pro subscribers get REST API access. Upload multiple files via HTTP POST, receive a merged PDF. See our API docs for examples.

size.question: What's the maximum file size for merging?
size.answer: Free tier: 20MB per file. Pro tier: 100MB per file. Total combined size limit is 200MB for Pro users.

mobile.question: Can I merge PDFs on my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes. SlimPDF works in mobile browsers on iPhone and Android. Upload files, arrange order, and download the merged PDF.

batch.question: How many PDFs can I merge at once?
batch.answer: Free: up to 5 PDFs per merge. Pro: unlimited PDFs at once. Perfect for combining large document packages.

seoContent.title: The Easiest Way to Convert Images to PDF

content.heading: Why Convert JPG to PDF?
content.text: PDF is the universal document format that works on any device. Converting JPG images to PDF makes them easier to share, print, and archive. Multiple photos become pages in a single document, keeping your images organized and in the right order.

content.heading: JPG to PDF vs PNG to PDF
content.text: Both JPG and PNG convert perfectly to PDF. Use JPG to PDF for photos, scans, and images where file size matters. Use PNG to PDF for screenshots, graphics, logos, and images with text where sharp edges are important. SlimPDF preserves quality for both.

content.heading: Choosing Page Size for Image to PDF
content.text: A4 (210 × 297mm) is the international standard for printing. Letter (8.5 × 11in) is the US standard. Original size keeps your image dimensions exactly as they are. Choose based on whether you plan to print or just view digitally.

content.heading: Tips for Converting Photos to PDF
content.text: Use high-resolution images for best results. Low-resolution photos will appear pixelated. For document photos, ensure good lighting and focus. If the resulting PDF is too large, use our compress tool to reduce file size while maintaining quality.

quality.question: Will converting to PDF reduce image quality?
quality.answer: No. SlimPDF preserves original image quality. Your photos look exactly the same in the PDF as standalone files. No compression is applied during conversion.

order.question: Can I arrange the page order?
order.answer: Yes. After uploading, drag images to arrange them. PDF pages will follow your exact order.

formats.question: What image formats can I convert to PDF?
formats.answer: SlimPDF supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, BMP, and GIF. For animated GIFs, only the first frame is converted.

pageSize.question: Can I set the PDF page size?
pageSize.answer: Yes. Choose A4 (international), Letter (US), or Original to keep your image's exact dimensions as the page size.

secure.question: Are my images secure?
secure.answer: Yes. All uploads use 256-bit encryption. Files are processed in isolated containers and auto-deleted after 1 hour (free) or 24 hours (Pro).

multiple.question: How many images can I convert to PDF at once?
multiple.answer: Free: up to 10 images per PDF. Pro: unlimited images per conversion. Each image becomes one page.

api.question: Can I convert images to PDF via API?
api.answer: Yes. Pro subscribers get REST API access. Upload images via HTTP POST, receive a PDF. See our API docs for examples.

size.question: What's the maximum image size?
size.answer: Free: 20MB per image, 100MB total. Pro: 50MB per image, 500MB total.

mobile.question: Can I convert photos to PDF on my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes. SlimPDF works in mobile browsers. Upload photos from your camera roll and download the PDF directly.

transparency.question: What happens to transparent PNG images?
transparency.answer: Transparent areas become white in the PDF. PDF format doesn't support transparency the way PNG does.
